info.name: Shopify Admin REST - Mobile E-Commerce App
info.description: Professional Shopify Admin REST API collection for a mobile e-commerce app. No real credentials are hardcoded. Requests use token-based Admin API authentication via X-Shopify-Access-Token. Never ship Admin API access tokens inside a mobile app; use Admin APIs only from Postman or a secure backend. REST Admin is legacy; prefer GraphQL Admin API for new public apps and Storefront API for buyer/cart/checkout flows.
